release_name: RevitCortex Precision Modeling Engine, Consultative Design SOP & Multi-Instance Resilience
highlights: RevitCortex Precision Modeling Engine: Safe transaction preprocessor (TransactionFailureHandling.SuppressWarnings) eliminating modal freezing, nearest level auto-snap, arc/curve wall support, and IFC DirectShape-to-Native rebuilding

Interactive Consultative Design SOP (revit-consultative-design): Professional Claude-inspired design workflow with programmatic client discovery, multi-agent milestone isolation, and visual ColorSplash verification checkpoints

End-to-End Milestone Office Building Generator: Complete 3-story office building (60 bored piles, 15 pile caps, 15 pedestals, 22 sloof, 15 columns, 66 beams, 4 floor slabs, 37 curtain walls, entrance canopy, 55 partitions, 20 doors, 9 stair flights, 28 native Revit Rooms, 6 QTO schedules with zero spatial clash)
Landmark Parametric Modeling Suite: Generative engines for Burj Khalifa Spire, Eiffel Tower, and Leaning Tower of Pisa
Multi-Instance HTTP Bridge Hardening: Automatic graceful handling of Error 183 (ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) in AIGRAVHttpServer, allowing multiple concurrent Revit instances without modal error popups
fixes: Resolved Revit journal fatal rollback caused by corrupted M_Door-Passage-Single-Flush sketch by decoupling transactions and strictly binding to M_Door-Single-Panel
Fixed structural column top offset alignment (+2.5m error) via dual BuiltInParameter enforcement (SCHEDULE_TOP_LEVEL_OFFSET_PARAM)
Fixed wall creation plane ArgumentException by enforcing exact level elevation coordinate alignment
Fixed HTTP Listener startup crash on multiple Revit instances opening simultaneously
